class _ItemDtoBase(BaseModel):
    # All fields except Primary Key
    name: str
    description: str

class ItemDtoRead(_ItemDtoBase):
    # with Primary Key 
    id: int

class ItemDtoCreate(_ItemDtoBase):
    # with Primary Key (required)
    # or without Primary Key is auto-generated
    id: int 

class ItemDtoFullUpdate(_ItemDtoBase):
    # without Primary Key (in URL) (PUT)
    pass  

class ItemDtoPartialUpdate(BaseModel):
    # Only updatable fields (PK in URL) (PATCH)
    name: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = None
